primarySources.title: Chromium main Mac trust-store implementation
primarySources.summary: Hostname-specific policy-string entries are ignored. Accepted Mac trust can apply to an anchor or a leaf, with expiry and anchor constraints enforced. Non-self-issued certificates use trustAsRoot.

primarySources.title: Chromium Chrome Root Store FAQ
primarySources.summary: The macOS verifier consumes explicit SSL trust settings for certificates in default and System keychains.

proposedForSoleOwnerReview.candidate: Certificate-specific SSL trustAsRoot for the exact prepared non-CA checkout.localhost leaf, without a hostname PolicyString.
proposedForSoleOwnerReview.reasoning: A single-SAN non-CA leaf may preserve certificate/hostname scope while avoiding the ignored policy-string form. This is an inference requiring review against the actual browser build and normal browser validation.
